# ECStay

> ECStay (Explore, Come, Stay; formerly Havn PH) is a website for finding boarding houses, bedspaces, shared rooms, private rooms and studios for rent in Davao City, Philippines. Website: https://www.ecstay.ph. Free for renters.

Each room shows photos, the monthly price, who can stay (female only, male only or mixed), the amenities, the house rules, the move-in costs and its exact spot on a map, plus the walking time to the nearest school or landmark. Renters search near their school, mall, hospital or office and filter by budget, room type, who can stay and amenities like aircon, own CR and Wi-Fi. The site is in English and Tagalog.

ECStay calls the owners and managers who list their places Keepers. Every listing is reviewed against the listing standards before it goes live. Renters ask the Keeper through ECStay, visit the room, then pay the Keeper directly; ECStay does not take rent payments.

Note: the rooms marked "Sample" are examples with stock photos, shown while real boarding houses are added. They are not for rent.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.ecstay.ph/): search by school, mall, hospital, office or area
- [All rooms in Davao City](https://www.ecstay.ph/rooms): every room on a list and a map
- [List your boarding house](https://www.ecstay.ph/list): for boarding house owners and landlords (Keepers)
- [About ECStay](https://www.ecstay.ph/about)
- [Help: questions and answers](https://www.ecstay.ph/help)
- [Listing standards](https://www.ecstay.ph/listing-standards): what is checked before a listing goes live
- [Contact](https://www.ecstay.ph/contact): contact form, or call or text 0995 510 4274 (+63 995 510 4274)
- [ECStay on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61574262600669)
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.ecstay.ph/privacy) and [Terms of Use](https://www.ecstay.ph/terms)

- By monthly budget: [under ₱3,000](https://www.ecstay.ph/rooms?max=3000), [under ₱5,000](https://www.ecstay.ph/rooms?max=5000)

## Questions and answers
- What is ECStay? A website for finding boarding houses, bedspaces, shared rooms, private rooms and studios for rent in Davao City. Each room shows photos, the monthly price, who can stay and its exact spot on the map.
- Where in Davao City are the rooms? Across the city, including Poblacion, Bajada, Obrero, Matina, Ma-a, Buhangin and Mintal. You can search near schools like AdDU, UM, USeP, SPC, HCDC, DDC and UP Mindanao, or near places like Gmall, SM Lanang, Abreeza, SPMC and Robinsons Cybergate.
- How do I contact a Keeper (the landlord)? Open the room and tap Contact Keeper. Send your name, mobile number, your move-in month and a short message. The Keeper gets it by email and in their dashboard, and replies through ECStay.
- How do I pay? You pay the Keeper directly, only after you have seen the room. ECStay does not take payments and will never ask you to pay by email or chat.
- How do I list my boarding house? Go to https://www.ecstay.ph/list and sign in with Google or with a 6-digit code sent to your email. Add your place's pin on the map, room types and monthly prices, the deposit and advance, who can stay, amenities, house rules and photos. ECStay reviews every listing before it goes live.
- Are the rooms verified? Every listing is reviewed against the listing standards (photos, price, location and details) before it goes live.
- Are the rooms on ECStay real? Rooms marked "Sample" are examples with stock photos, shown while real boarding houses are added. They are not for rent.
